message.content: BILL-77: we charged a customer twice because Stripe retried a webhook. Make the handler idempotent.

content.text: The handler now records each event id in a processed_events table inside the same transaction as the side effect, with a unique constraint. A retried event hits the constraint, rolls back, and returns 200 so Stripe stops retrying.

message.content: Stripe also has a rate limit on their API. Are we safe when we replay a backlog?

content.text: The replay script now sends at most 25 requests per second and backs off on 429 using the Retry-After header. A dry run over last week's 4,200 events finished in under four minutes.
